readmeMarkdown:
# Remote Cast (`chrome-stream-mcp`) **Your Chrome, live inside Antigravity.** Remote Cast streams a Chrome tab into the side panel so you can watch and steer what an agent is doing — click, type, switch tabs. Use your everyday Chrome or a separate clean profile; quality adapts to your network. [Homepage](https://remotecast.eatingdream.dev) · **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/remote-cast/releases) · [AI Guide](docs/ai-guide.md) · [`llms.txt`](llms.txt) [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/remote-cast/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/remote-cast/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/remote-cast/releases) ![Built with Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20with-Rust-12151E?logo=rust&logoColor=white) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-2952CC)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-181C28)
## Is It For You? - **Use Remote Cast** if you want to view, scroll, type, and switch tabs in your own Google Chrome (keeping existing logins and extensions) or a separate clean Chrome profile right inside Antigravity, even over a slow link. - **Skip it** if you only want an AI agent to browse or scrape autonomously — Antigravity's built-in `browser` subagent already handles general browsing without touching your Chrome. ## Why Remote Cast - **My Chrome or Separate Chrome**: Attach to your everyday Chrome with logins intact, or open a separate Chrome with a clean profile and no permission prompt. - **Standby-first Disconnect in the header**: Click **Pause** or **Standby** (`mode: "standby"`) to stop streaming at 0 FPS while keeping Chrome's Allow permission warm for instant 1-click **Resume Stream**; click **Revoke** (`mode: "revoke"`) when you explicitly want to sever the debugging session. - **Stays in the background on macOS**: Clicking, switching tabs, and opening new tabs (`chrome://newtab`) never steal window focus away from Antigravity. - **Adapts to slow networks, sharpens when still**: Pick **Auto**, **Saver**, **Low**, **Balanced**, or **High**. While you scroll or type it stays responsive, then settles into a crisp still frame with zero wasted bytes when idle. - **Settings right in the panel**: Click **Settings** (`⚙`) to change language, default quality, default connect mode, background refresh, and idle pause — backed by a hot-reloading `settings.json`. - **Fast, lightweight native panel**: Single Rust binary with a zero-dependency panel (`<= 64 KiB`), dark-first zero-flicker loading, and instant EN / 中文 switching. ## Quick Start ### 1. Install (macOS & Linux) ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/remote-cast/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Verifies SHA-256 checksums, installs into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/chrome-stream-mcp, and hot-reloads the MCP server automatically inside Antigravity (use --reload outside Antigravity or --no-reload to skip). Uninstall anytime with --uninstall. ### 2. Connect Chrome - **My Chrome**: Open `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` in Chrome and turn on remote debugging, then click **Connect my Chrome** in Remote Cast and click **Allow** once in Chrome. Use **Standby** or **Pause** when stepping away. - **Separate Chrome**: Click **Open separate Chrome** for a fresh, isolated local profile (`0700` permissions on `127.0.0.1`) with no permission prompt. It picks a free local port automatically so it runs cleanly alongside your everyday Chrome. ## For AI Agents Machine-readable tool schemas, `settings.json` keys, CLI diagnostics, and stdio setup: ```sh npx skills add eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/remote-cast ``` - **Agent Skill**: [`skills/chrome-stream/SKILL.md`](skills/chrome-stream/SKILL.md) - **Full AI & Configuration Guide**: [`docs/ai-guide.md`](docs/ai-guide.md) - **LLM Entry Index**: [`llms.txt`](llms.txt) ## Safety & Privacy - **Loopback-only (`127.0.0.1` / `::1`)**: Rejects non-loopback endpoints and never exposes Chrome debugging ports to your LAN or the internet. - **Same-user local socket**: Uses a `0600` Unix socket, checks peer user ID, and verifies ownership and permissions on sockets, `settings.json` (`0600`), and the `0700` separate profile. - **Explicit connect & idle pause**: Opening the panel never auto-connects to Chrome; screen capture pauses automatically while idle (default 12 s) and resumes on your next click or key. - **Sanitized diagnostics**: `chrome-stream-mcp doctor --json` omits local paths and raw debugging WebSocket URLs by default. ## Documentation - [AI Guide & Configuration Reference](docs/ai-guide.md) — MCP tools, `settings.json`, environment variables, CLI subcommands, build from source - [Agent Skill](skills/chrome-stream/SKILL.md) — On-demand agent workflow rules - [LLM Index](llms.txt) · [Contributor Guide](AGENTS.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md) ## Antigravity Plugin Suite Part of the [Antigravity Plugins](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins) suite: [Context Radar](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/context-radar) · [Clam Guard](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/clam-guard) · **Remote Cast** · [Colab Deck](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/colab-deck) · [Panel Kit](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/panel-kit) ## License Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
